record.title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
record.description: ECCO2 modeled sea-surface current flows colored by corresponding sea-surface temperature. The model simulates ocean flows at all depths; this visualization uses surface flows.
record.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio

numericalData.note: NASA SVS states that it identifies the datasets used but does not store the datasets themselves. The current website samples the rendered NASA visualization; it does not read ECCO2 numerical fields.
